items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Oh, Mrs. Jones, we have a request to play for Mrs. Jones. She wants to hear start us.

ctx.x: So this woman wrote Lee a note and gave it to the white bartender to pass it over to Lee. Because the band was playing on, this was on Burbin and I, the band's team was back, elevated, behind the bar. And he was getting on the other side. So this woman gave this note to him to read. I mean, for him to give to Lee. Lee read the note and answered it. And gave it back to this guy, because a guy like Lee. But just when he took, when he got ready to read for it, another guy on other side took the metal out of the…
And, and so, sometimes something happened that, that they... No, no.
